module purpose: This module stores four 32-bit words through a CSR write/read interface, then on a qualified start captures two 32-bit operands, updates internal sequencing and arithmetic state from funct3_i and the stored words, and reports a result word with a valid flag. active_i, funct7_i and rs3_i are declared but have no local use in the RTL or map.

use-case flows.value: a 32-bit word written into one of four stored entries when csr_we_i is asserted
the CSR-selected stored 32-bit entry returned on csr_rdata_o
capture of rs1_i and rs2_i and assertion of the internal done stage when start_i is asserted for the accepted instruction type
update of internal sum and result state from the latched operands, the stored 32-bit entries and the funct3_i-selected arithmetic path
selection of result_o and valid_o between the computed result path, the immediate init acknowledgement path, and zero/invalid outputs
clearing of the stored CSR words and all internal operation state while rstn_i is low

conceptual assets.concept: CSR-programmed four-word memory values used by readback and by the arithmetic transformation
conceptual assets.reasoning: The configure flow stores csr_wdata_i into key_mem on a clock edge when csr_we_i is asserted (line 179), reset clears the whole memory (line 176), readback returns the selected stored word on csr_rdata_o (line 185), and the operate flow consumes a selected stored word through tmp_z and tmp_r (lines 236-238). Integrity is established because both the returned CSR word and the computed result path depend on these stored values being exact. Availability is also established because the values are retained in key_mem between writes and reset and are readable at line 185.

conceptual assets.concept: Requested operation variant that selects the arithmetic, init, or invalid output path
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module reads rtype_i and funct3_i to choose behavior: rtype_i qualifies operand capture and sequencing at line 204 and gates the output process at line 245, while funct3_i selects the sum update branch (lines 213-218), the add/subtract result branch (lines 221-225), the operand and stored-word selection (lines 232-237), and the final result/valid cases (lines 247-256). Integrity is established because the operate and report flows must follow the exact selector values defined by those branches. Availability is conditionally established because when rtype_i matches and funct3_i selects a handled case, the corresponding computation or acknowledgement path is produced.

conceptual assets.concept: Latched operand words for the started operation
conceptual assets.reasoning: On a qualified start, the module captures rs1_i into xtea.opa and rs2_i into xtea.opb (lines 204-206). These stored words are then consumed by the operate flow: xtea.opa can initialize xtea.sum (line 214), and both xtea.opa and xtea.opb feed tmp_a, tmp_b, tmp_x and tmp_y (lines 232-235), which in turn drive xtea.res (lines 222 and 224). Integrity is established because the computed result depends on the exact captured operand words. Availability is also established because the operands are stored in registers and held until overwrite or reset.

conceptual assets.concept: Internal running sum state used for stored-word selection and result formation
conceptual assets.reasoning: The module stores xtea.sum, clearing it on reset (line 196), loading it from xtea.opa for one selector case (line 214), and otherwise updating it from its previous value by adding or subtracting the constant delta (lines 216 and 218) when xtea.done(0) is asserted. The current xtea.sum then selects which stored word becomes tmp_z (lines 236-237) and contributes directly to tmp_r (line 238). Integrity is established because the operate flow depends on this state evolving exactly as defined by lines 214, 216 and 218. Availability is established because xtea.sum is edge-stored and used on later cycles until reset or overwrite.

conceptual assets.concept: Arithmetic-operation completion state that controls when the result path is valid
conceptual assets.reasoning: The sequencing state is held in xtea.done: line 200 clears done(0) each cycle, line 201 shifts done(0) into done(1), and line 207 sets done(0) when start_i is asserted for the accepted instruction type at line 204. The same state gates the updates of xtea.sum and xtea.res at line 211, and for the arithmetic funct3_i cases valid_o reports xtea.done(1) at line 250. Integrity is established because incorrect completion state would cause wrong-cycle state updates or a wrong valid indication. Availability is also established because after a qualifying start the done state propagates through the defined pipeline stages and can be reported on valid_o for the arithmetic result path.

conceptual assets.concept: Computed arithmetic result word delivered on result_o
conceptual assets.reasoning: When xtea.done(0) is asserted, xtea.res is updated from tmp_b and tmp_r, using addition for one branch and subtraction for the other (lines 221-224), and tmp_r itself is derived from tmp_a, tmp_x, tmp_y, tmp_z and xtea.sum (line 238). For the arithmetic funct3_i cases, result_o copies xtea.res (lines 248-249). Integrity is established because the reported result must match these defined arithmetic combinations. Availability is conditionally established because the result is stored and reported when the arithmetic funct3_i cases are selected and rtype_i qualifies the output path.
